summary: Markets are in wait-and-see mode ahead of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first-ever Jackson Hole keynote on Friday, with September rate-hike odds already collapsed from 82% to 30% after weak retail sales and unexpected job losses, while the Fed held at 3.5–3.75% in July on a 9-3 vote.
tweet: Warsh hits the Jackson Hole podium Friday as the most consequential macro moment before September's FOMC — rate bets and crypto digital-asset policy signals both hanging on his words.
